254	## 5. Data model (Tiger Data / TimescaleDB)

256	### 5.1 Design rules
257	
258	- **Base units everywhere.** Store `quantity_base` in g, ml or count, and keep the user's `display_unit` alongside for display.
259	- **Nutrition per 100 g or 100 ml** is canonical. Per serving is derived, or stored when the source gives it.
260	- **Mutable state goes in plain tables:** `pantry_items`, `recipes`, `recipe_variants`, `cooking_sessions`.
261	- **Append-only, time-keyed data goes in hypertables:** `meal_logs`, `pantry_events`. A continuous aggregate `daily_nutrition` provides history charts.
262	- Hypertable constraints: unique indexes must include the partitioning column, and hypertable-to-hypertable foreign keys are unsupported ([Tiger limitations](https://www.tigerdata.com/docs/deploy/limitations/index.md); [primary keys](https://www.tigerdata.com/docs/learn/data-model/primary-keys-time-and-uniqueness)). Hence `PRIMARY KEY (id, eaten_at)`, and nothing references `meal_logs`.
263	- Hypertable syntax `WITH (tsdb.hypertable, tsdb.partition_column = '…')` and the continuous-aggregate and policy syntax come from [Tiger's continuous aggregate docs](https://tigerdata.com/docs/build/continuous-aggregates/create-a-continuous-aggregate). Continuous-aggregate `GROUP BY` must include `time_bucket` on the time column, and the source hypertable cannot use row-level security. That is fine here, because isolation is enforced in application code.
264	- **Nutrition in `meal_logs` is a snapshot.** Later recipe edits never rewrite history.
265	- **Every query is scoped by `user_id`**, which comes from `requireUser()` and never from the request body.

1519	#### 10.3.6 Schema subset reminders
1520	
1521	- **Supported:** types `string`, `number`, `integer`, `boolean`, `object`, `array`, `null`. Nullable fields use type arrays; there is no `nullable` keyword. Keywords `title`, `description`, `properties`, `required`, `additionalProperties`, `enum`, `format` (date/date-time/time), `minimum`/`maximum`, `items`, `prefixItems`, `minItems`/`maxItems`.
1522	- **Not enforced:** `minLength`, `maxLength` and `uniqueItems` are silently stripped.
1523	- **Size:** very large or deeply nested schemas can fail with 400 `INVALID_ARGUMENT`.
1524	- Source: [structured output](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/structured-output)
1525	
1526	### 10.4 Publisher recipe pages (schema.org Recipe)
1527	
1528	- **Properties:** Google's Recipe markup requires only `name` and `image`, and recommends `author`, `recipeIngredient` (one ingredient per string), `recipeInstructions` (preferably `HowToStep` with `text`), `recipeYield`, `nutrition.calories`, ISO-8601 `prepTime`/`cookTime`/`totalTime`, `recipeCategory` and `recipeCuisine` ([Google Search Central](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/recipe)).
1529	- **`recipe-scrapers`:** reads JSON-LD and microdata (`SchemaOrgPlugin`), falls back to OpenGraph, has site-specific scrapers plus a generic "wild mode", repairs broken JSON-LD, and returns a Zod-validated object. Call it as `scrapeRecipe(html, url)` ([architecture doc](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/recipe-scrapers@1.10.0/docs/architecture.md)).
1530	- **Server-side fetch:** only about 2% of crawls inject schema via JavaScript, so a plain fetch without a headless browser should usually be enough ([Digital Applied, Nov 2026](https://www.digitalapplied.com/blog/schema-markup-adoption-top-homepages-2026)). The share of *recipe pages* that carry Recipe markup is unquantified.
1531	- **Fallback extractor** (`server/recipes/jsonld.ts`): match `<script type="application/ld+json">` blocks, `JSON.parse` each one, walk arrays and `@graph`, and return the first node whose `@type` is `"Recipe"` or includes it.
1532	- **`recipeInstructions` normalization:** a string becomes one step per paragraph, `HowToStep[]` becomes their `.text`, and `HowToSection` is flattened in order.
1533	- **Yield:** take the first integer in `recipeYield`. If none, use 4 and flag it.

1535	### 10.5 ElevenLabs text-to-speech
1536	
1537	- **Request:** `POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}/stream?output_format=mp3_44100_128`
1538	  - Header `xi-api-key`.
1539	  - Body `{ text, model_id: "eleven_flash_v2_5" }`. The API default model is `eleven_multilingual_v2`, so **always set the model explicitly**.
1540	  - `optimize_streaming_latency` is deprecated.
1541	  - Source: [Stream speech](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech/stream)
1542	- **Why HTTP streaming:** it is the recommended mode "for cases where the input text is available up-front", which fits recipe steps. WebSockets are for incremental LLM text ([latency guide](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-api/guides/how-to/best-practices/latency-optimization.md)).
1543	- **Model choice:** Flash v2.5 has about 100 ms median model latency, up to 40,000 characters per request, 32 languages, and 50% lower per-character price. `eleven_turbo_v2_5` is deprecated ([Models](https://elevenlabs.io/docs/overview/models)).
1544	- **Cost:** Flash/Turbo API pricing is **$0.04 per 1K characters** ([API pricing](https://elevenlabs.io/pricing/api)). A 15-step recipe at about 150 characters per step comes to roughly $0.09, and caching makes repeat demos close to free.
1545	- **Route** (`app/api/tts/route.ts`):
1546	  1. Validate 1–2000 chars.
1547	  2. If there is no key, return 503 `UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE`.
1548	  3. Stream `r.body` through with `Content-Type: audio/mpeg` and `Cache-Control: private, max-age=86400`.
1549	  4. If the upstream response is non-2xx, return 502, and the client falls back.

1551	### 10.6 MediaPipe Tasks Vision
1552	
1553	- **Package and assets:** `@mediapipe/tasks-vision@1.2.2`. It ships two WASM variants of about 14.6 MB each, and types `FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks(basePath?, useModule?)`, `BaseOptions.delegate: "CPU" | "GPU"` and `recognizeForVideo(frame, timestamp)`, which is synchronous ([npm tarball](https://registry.npmjs.org/@mediapipe/tasks-vision)).
1554	- **Model file:** the canonical model URL is `https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/gesture_recognizer/gesture_recognizer/float16/latest/gesture_recognizer.task` ([overview](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/gesture_recognizer)). Download it once, commit it to `public/models/`, and **[VERIFY]** that the URL serves (research couldn't reach it through the sandbox proxy).

1556	- **Canned gestures:** None, Closed_Fist, Open_Palm, Pointing_Up, Thumb_Down, Thumb_Up, Victory, ILoveYou. **Handedness is reported for the subject's hand, and a mirrored image inverts it** ([overview](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/gesture_recognizer)).
